tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists tables in the curated schema. Call once per session.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Returns column names and types for a table. Call before writing a query against a new table.

tools.name: evaluate_sql
tools.description: Pre-flight evaluator for SQL. Returns OK or a list of issues. ALWAYS call before execute_redshift_query for any non-trivial SELECT.

tools.name: execute_redshift_query
tools.description: Executes a SELECT against the curated Redshift cluster. Read-only — refuses non-SELECT statements. Rows are returned as JSON.
